# mpbarbosa.com

> Marcelo Pereira Barbosa — Solutions Consultant and Engineer, São Paulo, Brazil. A 26-year career in telecom billing: invoicing, tax/accounting/financial reconciliation, revenue assurance, Oracle and PL/SQL. Over the past year, two products shipped to production, built by directing AI coding agents. **Available for senior positions — on-site, hybrid or remote.**

## Availability

- Open to senior roles in software engineering, data engineering, billing and revenue assurance.
- Based in São Paulo, Brazil. On-site, hybrid or remote.
- Contact: https://mpbarbosa.com/#contact · https://www.linkedin.com/in/mpbarbosa/
- Resume (PDF): https://mpbarbosa.com/cv/

## Products in production

- [Portal Brasileirão](https://brasileirao.mpbarbosa.com): Companion app for the Brazilian Série A championship. React 19, TypeScript, Express 5, Tailwind 4, AWS. 1,523 unit tests, 46 end-to-end Playwright specs, 910 commits in eight weeks, 7 GitHub Actions workflows including rollback with a documented flip-back drill, keyless deploys over OIDC, OAuth login, frozen-snapshot fallback when no API token is available.
- [Agora na Copa 2026](https://copa2026.mpbarbosa.com): Companion app for the FIFA World Cup 2026. React 19, TypeScript, Express, AWS. Monte Carlo qualification simulator using a Dixon-Coles model with the Article 13 FIFA tie-breaking criteria; per-integration fallbacks (FIFA API, Open-Meteo, Google Trends); nginx and systemd.

## Experience

- **Objective Solutions** (Mar 1999 – Dec 2023), 15 years as Senior Developer and around 10 as Consultant. Telecom billing: the Diginet product and its successor Objective NG, in Smalltalk, Java and PL/SQL on Oracle. Built the Billing and Tax data warehouses in PL/SQL. Consulting on tax, accounting and financial reconciliation, including the functional specification of the credit-card reconciliation system for the acquirer Adiq, in a Scrum team (Feb 2019 – Mar 2020); consulting presentations at Netserv, On and HughesNet; focal point for medical claims at PreventSenior. Four end-to-end data migrations: Oi Cabo (100k subscribers), Compuserve (35k), On (10k), Netserv (10k). Clients: Sky, Telefônica/Vivo, HughesNet, Netserv, PreventSenior.
- **Eleflow** (2024 – 2025), Senior Data Analyst. Oracle to BigQuery data migration, in a Scrum team.
- Education: Universidade Presbiteriana Mackenzie.

## Projects and tooling

- [ai_workflow](https://github.com/mpbarbosa/ai_workflow): Automation layer that makes AI-assisted development verifiable — so teams can trust what any AI coding tool generates before it ships.
- [conversando_com_pessoa](https://github.com/mpbarbosa/conversando_com_pessoa): Local RAG system in Python. Dense retrieval (multilingual-e5-base) combined with BM25, an index whose integrity manifest refuses to load an inconsistent index, a plagiarism guard calibrated on real answers, pluggable generation and a FastAPI web layer; orchestration is decided by rules, never by the model. On the gold set published in the repo README — 40 questions, 176 candidates graded by TREC pooling — dense retrieval reaches nDCG@5 0.719 against BM25's 0.488. 292 tests passing, 1 skipped. Runs locally; not deployed.
- [trilhas_estudos](https://github.com/mpbarbosa/trilhas_estudos): Study-track control and suggestion system in Python. Domain in frozen dataclasses with mypy --strict over all of src/; progress log event-sourced with UPDATE and DELETE forbidden by SQLite trigger, so correcting a fact means appending another event; suggestion engine of rules, explainable by construction — no suggestion without the factors that produced it. 294 tests over 6,772 lines, 16 ADRs, five CI gates per push and pull request on a 3.12/3.14 matrix. Runs locally; not deployed.
- [gitx](https://github.com/mpbarbosa/gitx): Git TUI integrated with assistants over the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- [olinda_copilot_sdk.ts](https://github.com/mpbarbosa/olinda_copilot_sdk.ts): TypeScript wrapper for the GitHub Copilot SDK.
- [Onde Estou?](https://mpbarbosa.com/guia_js/): Real-time geolocation app
- [MapaSP](https://mpbarbosa.com/mapasp/): Interactive map of São Paulo
- [Music in Numbers](https://mpbarbosa.com/music_in_numbers/src/music_in_numbers.html): Spotify data analysis
- [Monitora Vagas](https://mpbarbosa.com/monitora_vagas/public/): Hotel vacancy monitoring
- [mpb_scripts](https://github.com/mpbarbosa/mpb_scripts): Linux shell utility scripts
- Published to the npm registry, at early versions: bessa_patterns.ts, ibira.js, paraty_geocore.js.
- More than 50 non-fork public repositories at https://github.com/mpbarbosa
